neighbours.label: the word just before a feared break such as 'default', 'exit' or 'shutdown' (a Greek default, a no-deal exit, vote to leave)
fire: Bond traders are pricing in the risk of an Argentine default this year.
Business groups lobbied hard to prevent a disorderly exit from the bloc.
Congress has until Friday to avert a federal shutdown.
The prime minister warned of a chaotic no-deal departure in March.
Analysts see a growing chance of a sovereign default in Italy.
Scotland may hold another vote on whether to leave the United Kingdom.
Lenders fear that a Portuguese default would spread to Spain.
Officials scrambled to avoid a messy exit before the deadline.
quiet: Bond traders are celebrating an Argentine rally in stocks this year.
Business groups praised the generous trade deal signed with the bloc.
Congress passed the federal budget early on Friday.
The prime minister celebrated a smooth handover of power in March.
Analysts expect solid growth in Italy over the next year.
Scotland will receive more funding from the United Kingdom next year.
Lenders hope that Portugal's recovery will lift Spain too.
Officials finished the agreement well before the deadline.

notes: Card: tops sit right before no-deal Brexit, leave, hard landing, Greek default; the output promotes exit/default/shutdown/leaving (the + pole suppresses them). Probe: 0.33-0.74 on default/exit/shutdown contexts, 'possibility of a trade deal' 0.24. Near misses use other lead-ins (no risk framing) to avoid prefix leak.
